spans.s:
n. (-क्तं)
A sentence.
nf. (-क्तं-क्ता)
A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, one long or two short syllables in each.
mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Spoken, said.
E.
वच to speak, affix क्त and व changed to उ.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Said, was saying.
E.
वच to speak, क्तवतु affix of the past part.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
One who has borne testimony or given an opinion.
n. (-क्यं)
A dictum, a decree.
E.
उक्त and वाक्य dictum.

f. (क्तिः)
Speech, speaking.
E.
वच to speak, and क्तिन् aff.

m. (-रः)
Any brief or compendious phrase or description.
E.
उक्त what is said, उपसंहार compendiousness.

ind.
Having spoken or said.
E.
वच् to speak, क्त्वाच् aff.
